description: This file defines the AuditEntry class, an entity in the domain model representing audit log entries for actions performed within the application. It includes properties such as ID, creator information, client IP, action details, and context, with annotations for database mapping and serialization.

classes.name: AuditEntry
classes.description: Represents a record of an audit event, including details about the user, IP address, action taken, object affected, and optional context.

methods.name: ClientIp
methods.description: Getter and setter that convert between a byte array representation of the IP address and its string form.
